name: Tsukasa Strobilanthus
original_name: ツカサ・ストロビラントゥス
source:
★A beautiful boy protagonist with sexy, magical 'eyes'★

The protagonist of this story. He is slender and delicate in appearance, with a beautiful face.

He has a bright, positive, and serious personality, but looks considerably younger than his age (shota type) and is often mistaken for a girl.

In reality, however, he possesses a remarkably large penis and is incredibly virile. Due to a certain incident, he gains the magical power to "make members of the opposite sex intensely aroused just by making eye contact."

While training in magic under the old magician Hasturgal, he was one day invited to the magic academy by Sylvia and admitted through a special program. Tsukasa's goal at this magic academy is to learn magic and gain control of his 'eye' ability.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/mwa/index.html]Official Site[/url]]
